in_hebrew.name: רפאל
in_hebrew.meaning: רפאל אלוהים רופא כל חולים ומכאובים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רפאל הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים רופא' או 'רופא אלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'רפא' שפירושו 'לרפא' ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם רפאל מופיע בתנ'ך כדמות של מלאך הרפואה והשמירה על בריאות בני האדם. הוא נחשב לאחד המלאכים החשובים ביותר בתפיסת היהדות והנצרות.

in_greek.name: Ραφαήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ραφαήλ προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός θεραπεύει' ή 'Θεός ο ιατρός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ραφαήλ δεν αναφέρεται ρητά, αλλά η παράδοση της Εκκλησίας αναγνωρίζει τον Ραφαήλ ως έναν από τους επτά αρχαγγέλους, που συνδέεται με τη θεραπεία και την προστασία της υγείας των ανθρώπων.

in_latin.name: Raphael
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Raphael originem habet in lingua Hebraea et significat 'Deus sanat' vel 'Deus medicus'. In traditione christiana, Raphael consideratur unus de septem archangelis, qui praesidet sanitati et protectioni hominum. Nomen Raphael in Ecclesia Latina usurpatum est et in variis contextibus liturgicis et culturalibus apparet.

in_english.name: Rafaiel
in_english.meaning: God heals or God is the healer
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rafaiel originates from the Hebrew language, composed of 'Rapha' meaning 'to heal' and 'El' meaning 'God'. It signifies 'God heals' or 'God is the healer'. Rafaiel is associated with Raphael, one of the seven archangels in Christian tradition, known for his role in healing and protection. The name has been adopted in various Christian cultures, symbolizing divine intervention in health and wellness.

data.cultural_impact: Rafael is a Christian angelic name that has become popular due to the significance of the Hebrew origins of the name, which mean "God heals." This angel is often depicted in Christian art as a healer, and many people turn to Rafael for intercession when seeking physical, emotional, or spiritual healing. Additionally, the name Rafael is also popular in various Christian traditions around the world, including Latin America, Europe, and the Philippines.
data.spiritual_significance: Rafael represents the powerful and compassionate presence of God in our lives, offering healing and restoration. He is a reminder that even in times of pain and suffering, God is always there to offer comfort, hope, and healing. Rafael's name encourages us to trust in God's ability to heal and bring wholeness to our lives, and to turn to Him for guidance and strength during difficult times. May we be inspired by the name Rafael to seek God's healing touch and to be a source of healing and compassion to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Raphael, meaning "God heals," symbolizes divine healing and restoration in Christian tradition. As the angel of healing, he provides comfort and guidance, promoting physical and spiritual well-being.
